definitions.explanation: a figure from the Tanabata legend who represents the star Vega, separated from her lover Hikoboshi (Altair) by the Milky Way and allowed to meet him only once a year on the seventh of July

definitions.gloss: weaver woman; woman who weaves cloth
definitions.explanation: a woman whose occupation is weaving fabric on a loom

notes:
Written with {織|おり} (weaving) and ⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧ (princess, young woman). In its primary sense, {織姫|おりひめ} refers to the celestial weaver from the ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ (Tanabata) festival legend, based on the Chinese tale of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl. The star Vega in the constellation Lyra represents {織姫|おりひめ}, while Altair represents ⟦{彦星|ひこぼし}→彦星：26047_hikoboshi⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ festival on July 7th celebrates this story. People write wishes on ⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧ (paper strips) and hang them on bamboo branches, hoping for clear skies so the lovers can cross the ⟦{天|あま}の{川|がわ}→天の川：05050_amanogawa⟧ (Milky Way) to reunite.
